summary: Fractional seconds exceeding nine digits fail numeric conversion or exceed the scaling table, preventing complete parsing of valid timestamps such as 1987-07-05T17:45:00.123456789012345Z. The fix consumes all fractional digits but truncates the numeric representation to nine digits before conversion, preserving nanosecond precision and the original text for round-tripping. The selected test was added by this fix. Both reversal regions occur exactly once; replacing the fixed region produces the parent implementation file exactly. No tests were executed.
